about_item: Package Include: 1 Pc Brass Akhand Diya, Cotton wicks, Pitambari for that extra shine on the brass diya. Detailed Dos and Don'ts for proper usage.
Enhanced Clarity and Brightness: Crafted from high-quality borosilicate glass, it emits a brighter and more radiant light, enhancing your spiritual experience with its increased clarity.
Cool to the Touch: The Brass Diya is engineered to stay cool, even after long hours of repeated burning, ensuring your safety and comfort during worship.
Easy Maintenance: Cleaning and refilling the diya is a breeze, thanks to its thoughtful design. It's easy to keep it looking pristine and functional.
Care Instructions: Avoid using steel wool or wire mesh for cleaning. Always clean the glass portion with a soft sponge and liquid for lasting clarity and elegance.

summary.text: Customers find the fuel lamp to be of good quality and appreciate its appearance, with one noting the glowing light through the whole is beautiful. Moreover, they consider it good value for money and find it useful for daily puja time, with the flame lasting more than 12 hours a day and six teaspoons of oil lasting about 14 hours. However, the size receives mixed feedback, with some finding it good while others say it's smaller than expected. The heat resistance and durability also get mixed reviews - while the glass doesn't heat up and is strong enough to handle daily bumps, some report the top becoming very hot and the lamp breaking apart within a week.

authors_reviews.title: Just amazing
authors_reviews.text: It is by far the best thing I have ever bought online.Packaging perfectGood quality solid metal diya with the separate holder for the wick. The base is screwed to the upper part. The glass, as expected, excellent quality, does not heat up even when the diya has been burning for hours. The top though becomes very hot (obviously) so remember to pick it up using the glass and not the top metal. (I burnt my fingers once).Sometimes, if you have not placed the wick properly, then the flame will almost go out when you put the glass n top on the metal base. So you have to adjust the wick a little so that it keeps burning.Free things !! --1. superb quality kapoor2. Roli (the red thread for tying on the wrist)3. pitambari powder for cleaning the metal4. about 30 cotton wicksThe kapoor was of such excellent quality, it gave a very strong wonderful fragrance on burningWe never knew kapoor could be so strong and awesomeMy parents were also surprised and asking all about it 😁😁😁 sadly, I dont know the company of the kapoor, else I would order that separately too.Also, all the free things without any hulabaloo on the cover of the box - sophisticated and classy. 👌I bought the medium size - perfect for homes' mandirsYou can buy the small one for the office temples which would take up much less spaceLarge one - best for major poojas in the house like Diwali, or some Hawan... It would also make for an excellent gift. ♥️Overall, I am in love with it. And I admire it every time I pray. 😊😊😊Thank you Borosil, thanks a ton!
authors_reviews.author: Honest Reviewer

authors_reviews.title: Good product - works real well under breeze!
authors_reviews.text: Liked the concept so much that I ordered it. Except for my unable to use the first one I ordered due to a crack in the diya holder due to which oil was spilling all over, which would have been a rare specific item defect for all we know, I liked the product idea. Return & refund was extremely smooth thanks to the Seller and amazon - of course no cause for any loss of peace there! And then I went ahead and bought a Large & Medium sized diya from another seller (Olympia) for a much lesser price 549 & 375rs each and both are working good & now, it really feels worth all the trouble!Pros: It really doesn't blow out even will fan full ON which means you can still enjoy the 'bright & still light' & still keep yourself comfortable under a fan. Also useful to put it out on the verandah for sandhyas & occasions like Deepavali.Cons: Brass atop gets pretty hot - keep a piece of cloth to handle the brass top once diya is litWarning: Make double sure the holder holds oil well & there are no leaks, as soon as you get the item in hand, so that it is usable long run. If not, go for a refund and try buying another piece again, as I did :-)Wish amazon provided a replacement option as well in case such as these
